svg.text: Where the bytes live, where the rows live, and who may write
Written by xarray, a vendor or any Zarr tool
one row per object, with its
overlay rows win over the store's
writes go to the overlay; publish
anyone with MODIFY on the table

Many tables can register one store. Each registration keeps its own history, grants and overlay root, and sees the store plus only its own writes; there is no merge between them. A root (an overlay root
or a data root) has exactly one owner, decided by a Delta transaction in its _gbx_owner table.
